topics: Introduction to Occupational Health And Toxicology
Safety at work – Socio – Economic reasons.
Introduction to health and safety at various industries.
Toxic materials and substances used in work
Arrangements by organisations to protect the workers.
Chemical hazards - Dust, fumes, vapour, fog, gases
Biological hazards - Classification of Biohazardous agents– bacterial agents
control of biological agents at workplaces.
Noise, noise exposure regulation and control.
Radiation Hazards, Types and effects of radiation on human body
Safety in Construction industry  - Scaffolding and Working platform
control measures to reduce the risk.
Effects of shock on human body.
Safe working environment  - The basic purpose and benefits of safety inspection
Role of an individual in conservation of natural resources
role of individual in prevention of pollution.

partA.description: 2 Questions from each module.  Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description: Each question carries 9 marks.  Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.  Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Explain the Toxicology and Occupational Health associated with industries.
Identify chemical and microbial agents that originate in the environment and can impact human health.
Describe various measures to ensure safety in Construction industry.
Describe the safety measures against various environmental hazards.
